name: 69th Grammy Awards 2027
job: Help music fans distinguish nominations from ceremony and creators compare the published release and submission date windows without implying eligibility.
source_notes: Recording Academy lists nominations 16 November 2026 at 04:45 PT, ceremony 7 February 2027 at 16:00 PT; release window 31 August 2025–28 August 2026 and entry window 7 July–21 August 2026. Other eligibility rules apply.
